description: Save a re-runnable, parameterized workflow: an ordered list of natural-language instructions (step 1 builds, later steps mutate). Wrap values in {braces} and declare them in params. Running it later re-executes the instructions on FRESH data and bills per step like typing.

params.description: Declared parameters — every {slot} used in steps must be declared here.

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

steps.description: Ordered NL instructions. Step 1 builds the map; later steps mutate it. Wrap values in {braces} to declare parameters.

name: save_workflow
title: Save a workflow
